Commentary.Commentary: Unfortunately, sad news for all cricket fans, the game has been CALLED OFF. It was on the cards as the rain failed to relent and eventually the umpires have decided that the game will not be possible. Both the skippers are shaking hands and they share a point each. With this South Africa top Group B and they will face Australia in the Semi-Finals whereas England will face India. The Semi-Finals will be played on Thursday, 5th March, starting with India-England game followed by South Africa-Australia game. The action will start at 1500 Local (0400 GMT). Until then, take care and goodbye!
